trigger: An operator filters or builds a group on the old dashboard for a value of 2049 bytes up to about 2.6 KB (or a larger compressible value) in a response ingested after the upgrade
summary: Older servers indexed such values; after this change they are excluded from newly ingested responses, so the unchanged dashboard shows nothing or '0 agents will be added' for a value agents hold, and a direct group-from-results submit answers 422. The operator cannot tell this from 'no agent has it' on the page. The loss it replaces is worse (one value above about 2.7 KB dropped ALL facets of the response), the band is narrow, the upgrade note and fragment state it plainly, and the dashboard is being replaced within weeks, but the page itself does not explain it. Derived I3 / E3.

trigger: process record for the governance run over PR 1 (ingest bound only) of the #5623 re-cut
summary: FOR the PR 1 tip (efb9793df plus the fix commit that carries this ledger). OPEN: p1.dashboard-band is derived HIGH (I3, E3), introduced by this change and not fixed; the operator started this work after being told the old dashboard would show nothing or '0 agents' for such values and after choosing no GUI changes until the replacement ships, but has NOT explicitly waived the finding, so it is recorded as open and it gates the push until the operator says so. This is the ingest-only re-cut of the unpushed branch fix/5623-facet-value-bound (82 commits, whose own ledgers stay there); the REST/MCP preview refusal is PR 2 and depends on this PR and on the API-versioning carve-out PR; all dashboard changes are deliberately NOT carried. Gates run: a routed-concern walk of all four tables (matching rows: unit-test conventions, PostgreSQL store substrate, Prometheus metrics, docs-writer, C++ ownership and conventions); reviews by cpp-safety (with cpp-expert and security-guardian), quality-engineer (with consistency-auditor), docs-writer (with sre and compliance-officer), and an Astra opinion on the plan. Verified by the lead: no REST, MCP or dashboard file in the diff; the production diff read in full; the response-store, facet and tripwire tests pass against PostgreSQL 18 (1,326 assertions in 91 cases) with mutation checks by the code agent (exclusion removed, counters published before commit, seed call removed) each failing the expected test; PostgreSQL 18.4 index-limit probe repeated by the lead. A full meson suite on a trial merge of the first commit with origin/dev 78bb36f76 passed (92 ok, 0 fail, 2 skipped, Linux only); it is re-run on the final tip. NOT DONE: CI on this branch (Windows and macOS have not built it); an external model review; a second human review. RECORD LIMITS: every reviewer is a subagent of the lead session, so independence is asserted, not enforced; every row has source governance-agent with no reporter_ref; the rows were written after the fixes they describe; the operator's choices (restart as separate small PRs, no GUI changes) were relayed by the lead and are not signed by the operator; the two Sonnet implementation agents' own test claims were re-run by the lead.
